entries.title: A crewmate's browser page keeps its width beside its request
entries.body: The request a crewmate leaves beside its browser page no longer narrows the page: the page keeps its full width and the request sits next to it. On a small window the request folds to a single line under the page showing its latest message. Press Command-backslash, or click the line, to open or fold it.

picture.alt: A crewmate's browser page on a small window with its request folded to one line under the page, showing the crewmate's latest answer
